summary: Gauzy Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K disclosing a CEO-led PIPE: on October 12, 2026 it signed a securities purchase agreement with accredited investors led by CEO Eyal Peso for 2,383,279 ordinary shares at $2.9371/share, grossing $7,000,000, closing October 15, 2026. Proceeds fully finance a court-approved debt settlement (effective September 8, 2026) resolving roughly $61 million of liabilities; 3,336,590 shares issue in total, with 953,311 to Settlement Trustees. Post-closing ownership is about 50% purchasers, 20% trustees, 30% existing holders. A $1,638,000 tranche is conditioned on Lyon Commercial Court approval of subsidiary Safety Tech SAS's continuation plan by November 13, 2026. Watch the French court outcome as the key refund/cancellation risk.
